about_the_game:
This playable demo includes the opening section of Qume: Echoes of Sand.
Played from a first-person perspective, it lets you experience the game’s core mechanics — survival, looting, driving, and combat — set in a vast, dust-covered desert world.

Demo Content

✔️ The tutorial sequence from the game’s opening
✔️ Core gameplay mechanics: looting, raiding enemy camps, weapon handling, and vehicle driving
✔️ A brief showcase of the caravan system, radar display, inventory management, and resource scanning
✔️ A taste of the desert atmosphere and survival experience

The demo ends when the tutorial sequence is completed.
It does not include the full version’s open-world exploration, advanced crafting system, full weapon customization, or long-term survival loop.

What Awaits You in the Full Game

✔️ A harsh, realistic survival experience
✔️ A fully customizable AR-15 rifle with modular attachments
✔️ Procedurally generated endless desert world
✔️ Authentic looting and crafting systems
✔️ Physics-based vehicle handling with suspension and weight simulation
✔️ Upgradeable caravan with engine, armor, and storage improvements
✔️ Dynamic world with dust storms, environmental hazards, and enemy camps

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains frequent combat with depictions of blood and violence. Players engage in gunfights and melee combat against human and non-human enemies. Some scenes may be intense for sensitive players.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500K veya AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 veya AMD Radeon R9 380
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 veya AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Super veya AMD RX 5600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space

short_description: The world has been buried in dust. For those left behind, the sand is quieter than death. Become one of the survivors in Qume and uncover the secrets hidden behind the silence.
supported_languages: English, French, German, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Spanish - Latin America, Russian, Turkish
